task: Stop cropping the Hosted Applications cover image to its top (object-cover object-top) so it is centered with its main content visible on the catalog card and the details PREVIEW block (EPMCDME-17137).

key_reasoning.reason: AC are defined, but the fit choice is still open. Centered crop (object-center) or a non-cropping fit (object-contain over the generated wash/initials)? AC2 'not cut off' may need the non-cropping fit for non-2:1 images, and the server /thumbnail processing is unknown.

One shared component, HostedApplicationCover, serves both affected surfaces (catalog card, details PREVIEW). A second copy of the rule in HostedCoverField's chosen-file preview should change with it so the form preview keeps matching the card. Two UI components, no layer boundary crossed.

Class-level Tailwind change with an existing object-fit convention in the repo (Avatar/MCPServerCard object-cover, ImagePreview/LogoSection object-contain). No security or performance surface, and rollback is trivial. Verification is visual only, in a browser, because jsdom cannot assert layout. Total 9 sits at the XS/S boundary; leaned lower because Technical Risk is XS and existing patterns cover the change. Agrees with the bundled XS anchor epmcdme-10101-add-logging-to-endpoint.
